NOTE
**Still not ready — commit message still breaks the style guide**

New: The author pushed twice and shortened the commit title, but the code is unchanged (+17/-6 in the same 2 files). Missing: the title now has no space after "web:", doesn't start with a capital letter, doesn't end with a period, and the commit has no body explaining why.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and let laurynmm, who gave the feedback, follow up.

###### Reply

```quote
Not quite yet: the commit title still needs the form "area: Capitalized summary." (a space after the colon, a capital letter, and a period at the end), and the commit needs a short body explaining why. Please re-read the [commit message guidelines](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/version-control.html#commit-messages) and compare with recent commits in `git log`.
```
